runs.sourceText: THE CORE IDEA

transcript.text: THE CORE IDEA

runs.text: Market equilibrium occurs where quantity demanded equals quantity supplied. At that price, buyers can purchase the amount they want and sellers can sell the amount they offer, so there is no pressure for price to change. A demand or supply shift creates a new intersection and can change both equilibrium price and equilibrium quantity.
